method: Each claim checked against the retrieved text of the ASHM trichomoniasis page. Doses and intervals compared character by character. RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-22: the page in retrieved_from was fetched again and every claim attributed to this source was re-checked against it. Quotes stored from the earlier scrape carried that scrape's table and list markup (pipes, numbered list markers) into the quoted string; each was replaced with the text the page actually carries, located by alignment against the retrieved copy (scripts/repair_quotes.py). No dose, duration or concentration changed: the set of numbers in every repaired quote was compared before and after, and the only difference across 156 repaired quotes was list numerals 1-4 becoming bullets. Where a reference superscript falls inside a quoted sentence the page renders it inline, so it appears in source_text; it is part of the retrieved text, not part of the assertion.

claims.claim: In Australia trichomonas is more common in older people, people from regional and remote areas, especially Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, and street-based sex workers
claims.source_text: In Australia, trichomonas is more common in older people, people from regional and remote areas, especially Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and street-based sex workers.

claims.claim: It is an uncommon cause of vaginal discharge or penile urethritis in urban settings
claims.source_text: Uncommon cause of vaginal discharge or penile urethritis in urban settings.

claims.source_text: Partners with a penis may test negative for trichomonas as it is more likely to resolve spontaneously in these people.

claims.claim: First pass urine NAAT is available in major laboratories in each state
claims.source_text: First pass urine (FPU) NAAT Available in major laboratories in each state

claims.claim: Avoid alcohol with metronidazole treatment and for 24 hours thereafter
claims.source_text: Avoid alcohol with metronidazole treatment and for 24 hours thereafter.

claims.claim: Advise no sexual contact for 7 days after treatment is commenced, or until the course is completed and symptoms resolved, whichever is later
claims.source_text: Advise no sexual contact for 7 days after treatment is commenced, or until the course is completed and symptoms resolved, whichever is later.

claims.source_text: Trichomoniasis is only a notifiable condition in the Northern Territory.

claims.source_text: Re-infection and poor adherence should be ruled out in persistent or recurrent infection.
